Key.Original: Manufacturer: Bergmann Waffenfabrik%1Length: 32.8 inches%1Ammunition: 9×19mm Parabellum%1Rate of Fire: 450 rpm%1Weight: 4.09kg%1Firing Mode(s): Automatic%1Magazine: 32-round detachable drum magazine%1Effective Range: 200 meters%1%1The MP 18/I is a submachine gun that first entered service during the closing months of the First World War. Chambered in 9×19mm Parabellum, the MP 18/I fed from a TM 08 Luger snail drum magazine. Designed by Hugo Schmeisser and manufactured by Bergmann Waffenfabrik, it operated on a simple blowback action and was the first practical submachine gun to see combat.
